title: Route Exception Form
subtitle: Route Exception: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Route Exception Form covers route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan. The dispatch exception coordinator records Route Exception activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Route Exception Form keeps Route Exception exceptions visible until the dispatch exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Route Exception Form at current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point. Document route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan identity before Route Exception begins. Compare route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan findings with stated Route Exception criteria; route unresolved Route Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Route Exception Form, confirm requirements for Route Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Route Exception conditions beyond the dispatch exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Route Exception, identify responsible parties, current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point, and the linked route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan source.

fields.label: Event time, location, and service commitment

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Route Exception facts for route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Route Exception operating checks
items: Exception type and immediate safety state
Vehicle, cargo, driver, road, weather, and customer impact
Last completed and next affected stop
Reroute, rescue, transfer, return, or wait option

sections.title: Operating exception, outcome, and review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Route Exception conditions; have dispatch exception coordinator assign the next Route Exception owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Route Exception when safe location, driver fitness, vehicle condition, cargo custody, or authorized recovery remains unresolved. Retain the available Route Exception proof and route unresolved route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan scope to dispatch exception coordinator.
